contracts: Player.Potions enumerates nonnull physical slots in slot order
RemovePotionInternal replaces one physical slot with null; it does not shift later potions
AddPotionInternal defaults to first empty slot; explicit occupied preferred slot fails without moving to another open slot
PotionCmd.ShouldProcure precedes preferred index access and capacity failure
PotionModel.OnUseWrapper removes the used potion before its effects, then AfterPotionUsed
BeltBuckle removes Dexterity at AfterPotionProcured and gains it after last-potion use/discard
EntropicBrew creates/procures one potion at a time and stops after the first failed procure
NPotionPopup permits normal discard without another pending offer and CanRemovePotions disables both manual use and discard
saved_representation: Packed RunState.potions plus authoritative parallel flags.potion_slot_indices; explicit slots survive JSON reload. Old absent mappings infer contiguous slots. Explicit legacy MT fixtures retain packed semantics unless a slot mapping is supplied.
